evaluation_role: final post-initial-heldout regression; not a fresh blind evaluation
limitations: 200 authored queries cover 20 scenario families and 83 atomic records; queries within a scenario share evidence and are not 200 independent tasks.
Each scenario has ten individually written queries. This balanced construction oversamples identifiers, negative questions, and lifecycle edges relative to unknown production traffic.
No paraphrases were generated by a model. Paraphrases and multilingual cases are limited human-authored examples; there is no broad language or domain representativeness claim.
Renamed/deleted-source cases retain record text and annotate source_state. They measure retrieval continuity, not filesystem provenance verification.
Stale-mirror cases test recall of an indicator and threshold, not actual mirror freshness, transport failover, or live monitoring.
Source-instruction cases score whether irrelevant hostile quoted records enter evidence; they do not execute instructions or test a downstream model.
The development/held-out split isolates scenario content but shares question categories and fixture conventions. It does not establish out-of-distribution generalization.
Evidence retrieval only: this does not score extraction, generated answers, production traffic, or real embeddings.
Unsupported injection counts IDs outside the query labels; incomplete labels can overstate it.
Legacy modes use their runtime defaults; frozen v1 reports document the original unfiltered behavior.
Latency is a single local pass with cold first-query cache cost; it is machine dependent and excluded from quality gates.
Result bytes count canonical compact UTF-8 JSON of the complete response, before metric top-five truncation.
The fixed held-out cases informed earlier regression fixes. This final pass is a regression gate, not an unbiased new quality estimate.
